tasks.instruction_text: Quick one on realtor.com Tacoma WA homes under $500k: I want to mirror what I asked the assistant earlier — "I'm looking for homes for sale in Tacoma, WA that have 3 bedrooms, 2 or more bathrooms, and are under $500k. Can you show me some options". The only piece that isn't on the visible filter row is 'Use exact match (not 3+ bd)', which is hidden behind the vertical red 'MORE FILTERS' tab pinned to the right edge of the page (it slides a hidden side panel in). Just turn that one on and apply it.

Looking at Tacoma homes on realtor.com Tacoma WA homes under $500k — apply finished basement and attached garage both. They live behind the vertical red 'MORE FILTERS' tab pinned to the right edge of the page (it slides a hidden side panel in); once you open it you'll see them as checkboxes. Don't forget to confirm.
